lines.t: In the quiet of the morning light
I hear your whisper soft and bright
The dew is mercy on the ground
In this place your love is found
Every breath a gentle prayer
Every tear you've counted there
In the silence I can see
You've been waiting here for me
In this garden of stillness
I am whole
Your peace restores my weary soul
No noise, no fear
Just your embrace
Heaven blooms within this place
The world fades out
Your truth remains
You wash away my hidden stains
A stream of grace runs clear and free
You plant new life inside of me
Here I lay my burdens down
You lift my eyes from the ground
Yeah, who's sure you'll calm the storm inside
And your love I will abide
In this garden of stillness I am whole
Your peace restores my weary soul
No noise, no fear
Just your embrace
Heaven blooms within this place
Let these stillness never fade
In your light I'm unafraid
The garden grows where you remain
Forever still, forever changed
Ooh, ooh, ooh
